snippet.title: Rock and Found: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5203560/Rock_and_Found/

Rock and Found is a cozy game about identifying and sorting your late grandma's rock collection. Scratch it, lick it, hold a UV lamp to it, then find where it goes on her shelves.

Every rock has a home.

Demo on Steam Sep 28. Full game out Nov 16, 2026. Wishlist it above.

Discord: https://discord.gg/AdCsJA8NXU
Bluesky: @rockandfound.bsky.social
Instagram: @rockandfoundgame
TikTok: @rockandfound

Music: The Blue Danube by Johann Strauss II, arranged and recorded for this trailer

Made by one person, by hand.

#cozygames #indiegame #rocks
